name: Mad Labs - 2g Disposable - Guava Kush
description:
Tropical, smooth, and easy to love. The Mad Labs Guava Kush disposable brings a full 2 grams of premium oil in a sleek, ready-to-go device — no charging setup, no cartridges, no fuss. Just draw and unwind.

Guava Kush is an indica-leaning hybrid that blends sweet tropical fruit with classic Kush depth. Expect ripe guava and juicy citrus on the inhale, rounded out by earthy, subtly spicy Kush notes on the finish. The effect settles in warm and mellow — a relaxed, body-easing calm that's perfect for winding down after a long day or slipping into a laid-back evening without knocking you out completely.

Why you'll love it:

2G of premium oil — long-lasting and built to go the distance
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Guava Kush flavor — sweet tropical guava meets earthy Kush
Relaxed hybrid effects — mellow and soothing, ideal for evenings

Rich flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Mad Labs Guava Kush is ready whenever you are.
